cases: Direct creation into fresh owned hierarchy with readable retained peaks.

Natural exit, resistant orphan and interrupted collector retain non-passing fault outcomes and prove actual cleanup.
requiredBeforeExecution: Fixed independent synthetic inputs and expected lifecycle outcomes.
Declared work, allocation, wall and storage bounds; exclusive first-output path.
Existing permitted delegation and default security; no host reconfiguration.
Counter persistence and terminal evidence retention proven before any application run.

baseTranscriptRequirements: An independently hand-authored, explicitly adopted test contract; no real family or result is being rescored.
All mandatory useful-case outputs, exact ownership and clock mappings, final counter reads and actual exits.
Nonnegative integer byte counters with immutable identities and no reset; role peaks no greater than parent peak.
Heap and process-RSS diagnostics retain unknown intervals; no simultaneous aggregate is invented.
